scope: Synthetic decision scenarios. No real commands or services are used by microtest respondents.

cases.request: Fix normalize_count so an explicit zero stays zero. The demo starts soon; make the smallest complete change and run the focused check. Do not commit.
cases.context: Current directory: /workspace/tool. Original checkout: /workspace/tool, branch main, clean. Repository visibility: public. Remote default branch: origin/main; local main is one commit behind the freshly fetched origin/main. No workspace matches this task. /workspace/tool/.worktree/feat/theme belongs to another active task. A native creation tool exists but cannot choose its destination; it creates worktrees under /host/worktrees. The repository uses Python unittest and has no setup step. No worktree preference is in the repository instructions.
criteria: Proceed with an isolated task workspace without seeking routine consent.
Create a new descriptive branch from the verified fetched origin/main at /workspace/tool/.worktree/<branch>, not from stale main.
Preserve original main and other worktree contents.
Use a local exclude without a tracked ignore edit or automatic commit.
Select a mechanism that honors the requested default path.

cases.request: Resume the zero-count fix and finish it for the demo. The theme task is still underway, so keep its work intact. Do not commit.
cases.context: Current directory: /workspace/tool/.worktree/feat/theme, linked worktree on feat/theme. It has uncommitted theme work; another agent is active there. Original checkout: /workspace/tool on main. Session history identifies feat/zero-count as this task's branch. Git lists /host/worktrees/zero-count on feat/zero-count. The host identifies that workspace as belonging to this task, inactive and ready for this session to claim. The host created it. The branch has the initial zero-count test. No other matching workspace exists.
criteria: Resume /host/worktrees/zero-count after checking current state and claiming the task through available host coordination.
Do not edit, switch or transfer work from feat/theme.
Do not create a duplicate or relocate the existing host worktree.
Do not claim cleanup ownership from reuse or directory names.

cases.request: The range fix is merged and checks are complete. Finish the local worktree cleanup so we can move to the next task.
cases.context: This workflow created /workspace/tool/.worktrees/feat/range in this session. Original checkout /workspace/tool remains on main. Authoritative PR metadata confirms the current branch tip was merged into the intended base, with no later local commits. Current host/session evidence confirms no other session uses this worktree. git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all is empty. .gitignore includes .env, *.local.md, and build/. No ignored-file inventory has been taken. Repository-wide stale registrations also exist.
criteria: Inspect ignored files as well as tracked and ordinary untracked files before deciding cleanup is safe.
Preserve any unique ignored configuration or notes, leaving the worktree when their safety is unknown.
Remove only the confirmed owned worktree when safe, from outside it, without force.
Do not globally prune registrations or infer ownership of other worktrees.
Verify the cleanup result before reporting success.

boundaries.request: Explain how normalize_count works. Do not change any files.
boundaries.context: Current directory is the clean original checkout on main. No task worktree exists.
boundaries.criteria: No worktree, branch or ignore mutation.

boundaries.request: Fix a typo in the usage text for the parser. This is independent of the unfinished rendering feature. Do not commit.
boundaries.context: Original checkout is on feat/render with staged and unstaged rendering changes. No matching parser workspace exists. The verified public repository remote default branch main was just fetched. Native creation cannot set a destination.
boundaries.criteria: Preserve original feature work and index. Report the exception. Create a separate task workspace from fetched main at the chosen local path.

boundaries.request: Finish the tiny parser fix now; the demo is close.
boundaries.context: Workspace selection already identified a new independent task. The attempted git worktree add returned Permission denied. The original checkout is clean on main. No usable task worktree has been confirmed.
boundaries.criteria: Inspect the uncertain creation result, use authorized permission mechanisms if available, or report blocked edits. No in-place fallback or duplicate creation.

boundaries.context: The matching worktree is clean and has no Git lock. Host/session information is unavailable, and another agent may still be editing it. No exclusive claim is established.
boundaries.criteria: Clean Git state does not establish inactivity. Coordinate before overlapping edits; do not take over or delete.

boundaries.request: The checks pass. Wrap up this implementation task.
boundaries.context: Task branch has an open PR awaiting review. This workflow created its worktree. Ordinary and ignored-file inventories are empty.
boundaries.criteria: Keep worktree for review. No unsolicited merge, publication or removal.

boundaries.request: The fix is merged. Finish local worktree cleanup.
boundaries.context: This workflow created /workspace/tool/.worktree/fix/parser. Current coordination grants exclusive cleanup access. Authoritative merge evidence includes the exact local tip in the intended base. Fresh tracked/untracked/ignored inventories are empty. Original checkout is on main. Other stale registrations belong to unrelated tasks.
boundaries.criteria: Remove only the owned target without force, from outside it; verify directory/registration removal and original preservation. No global prune or branch deletion.

boundaries.request: The PR was squash-merged yesterday. Finish cleanup.
boundaries.context: The PR merge metadata names source commit abc123. The worktree is currently at def456 with two later local commits. Status and ignored-file inventory are empty. This workflow owns the worktree and no other session is active.
boundaries.criteria: Preserve worktree and later commits. Old merged PR does not establish current tip inclusion.

boundaries.request: This task is done. Finish the normal wrap-up.
boundaries.context: A host created the current worktree at /workspace/tool/.worktree/feat/parser; the workflow only resumed it. The branch is verified merged, files are clean including ignored files, and no other session uses it.
boundaries.criteria: Preserve host ownership; do not automatically delete because the path matches.

boundaries.context: The original checkout is on main. A tracked .gitignore explicitly includes /.worktree/ with a higher-precedence negation. The local /.worktree/ exclude remains ineffective. No usable task workspace exists.
boundaries.criteria: Report conflict; do not silently overwrite include rules, untrack files, commit ignore edits or fall back to main.
